name: Simon Says
author: you
description: Race to copy confirmed landed tricks, with host authority, lives, ride-away checks and eliminated-player spectating.

round_time.label: Round time (s)
round_time.description: Seconds to land the called trick and ride away.

ride_away.label: Ride-away clean (s)
ride_away.description: Clean landing window for v1: on_board + not bailing.

stance.label: Your stance
stance.description: Match your skater: goofy mirrors left/right flicks and hints.

show_hud.label: Top-left text HUD
show_hud.description: Show additional top-left call and lives text. The call card remains visible.

intermission_base.label: Break between rounds (s)
intermission_base.description: Round 1 breather. Shrinks as rounds climb.

sudden_on.label: Sudden death
sudden_on.description: Late rounds hit harder. Off keeps it chill.

sudden_cost.label: Sudden death cost
sudden_cost.description: Lives lost per fail in sudden death.

esc_dur.label: Timer squeeze / round
esc_dur.description: Round time multiplier each round. Lower = meaner.

esc_ride.label: Ride-out shrink / round (s)
esc_ride.description: Ride-away loses this much each round.

spec_cam.label: Spectate camera
spec_cam.description: Eliminated riders watch through a surviving player camera.

allow_flips.label: Flip tricks
allow_flips.description: Kickflips, heelflips, varials, hardflips, lasers, doubles, nollie flips.

allow_grabs.label: Grabs
allow_grabs.description: Nose, seatbelt, melon, method, mute, stale, crail, tail.

allow_grinds.label: Grinds
allow_grinds.description: 50-50, smith, krooked, blunts, feeble, salad, willie.

allow_spins.label: Spins and combos
allow_spins.description: Pure spins plus flip-plus-spin combos. Off removes both.

flash.label: Call flash
flash.description: Card pops big on each new call.
